load.note: Upstream steady_clock around one context creation; filesystem cache may be warm.

timing_method: ed-sample steady_clock per-pass stdout, rounded to 1ms; host system_clock phase intervals

unavailable_metrics.text_encode_ms: Encode phase includes conditioning and latent/schedule setup; retained as encode_setup in stages.csv.
unavailable_metrics.denoise_step_i_ms: Engine prints completed steps without individual timestamps.
unavailable_metrics.postprocess_ms/other_ms: Final tensor-to-image conversion not separately timed; no comparable text boundary.
unavailable_metrics.device_used_peak_gib: Only whole-child NVML peak; sampler and phase clocks not aligned.
unavailable_metrics.peak_alloc_gib/peak_reserved_gib/host_rs: No per-generation allocator or RSS observations.
unavailable_metrics.deterministic_output: Only final repeat image retained; preceding image hashes unavailable.
